1.word_for_word: एकत्रिंशे निराशास् ताः पुनः पुलिनम् आगताः । — At thirty-one, disappointed, they returned to the bridge.; कृष्णम् एवानुगायन्त्यः प्रार्थयन्ते तद्-आगमम् ॥ओ॥ — They follow Krishna alone, singing and praying for His coming.; जयति इति । — It is called Jayati.; हे दयित ! — O beloved!; ते जन्मना व्रजोऽधिकं यथा भवति, तथा जयत्य् उत्कर्षेण वर्तते । — They are born in Vraja, and as Vraja is increased, so Jayati is in excellence.; यस्मात् त्वम् अत्र जातः, तस्मद् इन्दिरा लक्ष्मीर् अत्र हि श्रयते, व्रजम् अलङ्कृत्य वर्तते । — Since you were born here, Indira Lakshmi resides here and adorns Vraja.; एवं व्रजे सर्वस्मिन् मोदमानेऽत्र तु तावकास् त्वदीया गोपी-जनास् त्वयि त्वद्-अर्थम् एव कथञ्चिद् धृता असवो यैः, ते त्वां विचिन्वते । — Thus, while I am enjoying everything in Vraja, here are your gopīs, who have somehow carried the Asavas in your arms for your sake, and they are searching for you.; अतस् त्वया दृष्यतां प्रत्यक्षी-भूयताम् इति । — Therefore, let you see and become a witness.; यद् वा, अस्माभिर् भवान् दृष्यताम् । — Or else, let us see you.; यद् वा, एवं त्वया दृष्यताम्---एते विचिन्वत इति ॥१॥ — Or else, let you see it thus: These are searching.
1.translation: At thirty-one, disappointed, they returned to the bridge. They follow Krishna alone, singing and praying for His coming. It is called Jayati. O beloved! They are born in Vraja, and as Vraja is increased, so Jayati is in excellence. Since you were born here, Indira Lakshmi resides here and adorns Vraja. Thus, while I am enjoying everything in Vraja, here are your gopīs, who have somehow carried the Asavas in your arms for your sake, and they are searching for you. Therefore, let you see and become a witness. Or else, let us see you. Or else, let you see it thus: These are searching.

2.word_for_word: अत्र स्वतन्त्राणां बाहूनां वक्तृत्वाद् अपरा आहुर् इति सर्व-श्लोकेष्व् अवतारणा । — Here, since the independent arms are the speakers, others say that they are the incarnation in all the verses.; अथापि सङ्गतिर् उच्यते---तत्र विचिन्वन्तु मम किम् ? — Yet the association is said to be: let them search there, what is mine?; इति चेत् तत्राहुः---शरद्- इति । — If so, they say there is autumn.; शरद्-उदाशये शरत्-कालीने सरसि साधु जातं सम्यक् जातं यत् सरसिजं विकसितं पद्मम्, तस्य उदरे गर्भे या श्रीः, तां मुष्णाति हरतीति तथा तया दृशा नेत्रेण । — In the autumn heat, in the autumn season, the lotus that has grown well in the lake, the lotus that has developed in the lake, and the beauty that is in its belly and womb, is being robbed and taken away by that eye.; हे सुरत-नाथ ! — O Surat-Nath!; संभोग-पते ! — Sambhog-pate !; वरद ! — Varad!; अभीष्ट-प्रद ! — Wish-fulfilling!; अशुल्क-दासिका अमूल्य-दासीर् नो निघ्नतो मारयतस् ते तव त्वया क्रियमाण इह लोकेऽयं वधो न भवति किम् ? — Free maid, precious maid, killing us by killing us, isn't this the murder you are doing in this world?; शस्त्रेणैव वधो वधः, किं दृशा वधो न भवति ? — Killing with a weapon is killing, isn't it killing by sight?; किन्तु भवत्य् एव । — But it does happen.; अतस् तव दृशाऽपहृत-प्राण-प्रत्यर्पणाय त्वया दृश्यताम् इति भावः । — Therefore, let your sight be seen to restore the life that has been taken away from you.; त्वया दृश्यताम् [१] इति यथा-संभवं सर्वत्र वाक्य-शेषः ॥२॥ — Let you see [1] is the rest of the sentence everywhere as much as possible.
2.translation: Here, since the independent arms are the speakers, others say that they are the incarnation in all the verses. Yet the association is said to be: let them search there, what is mine? If so, they say there is autumn. In the autumn heat, in the autumn season, the lotus that has grown well in the lake, the lotus that has developed in the lake, and the beauty that is in its belly and womb, is being robbed and taken away by that eye. O Surat-Nath! Sambhog-pate ! Varad! Wish-fulfilling! Free maid, precious maid, killing us by killing us, isn't this the murder you are doing in this world? Killing with a weapon is killing, isn't it killing by sight? But it does happen. Therefore, let your sight be seen to restore the life that has been taken away from you. Let you see [1] is the rest of the sentence everywhere as much as possible.

3.word_for_word:
किं च, बहुभ्यो मृत्युभ्यः कृपया रक्षित्वा किम् इतीदानीं दृशा मन्मथं प्रेष्य घातयसीत्य् आहुः---विष- इति । — Moreover, after mercifully saving him from many deaths, why do you now send him to kill Manmatha? They say that he is poison.; हे ऋषभ ! — O bull!; श्रेष्ठ ! — The best!; विष-मयाज् जलाद् योऽप्ययो नाशस् तस्मात्, तथा व्याल-राक्षसाद् अघासुरात्, वर्षान् मारुताद् वैद्युतानलाद् अशनि-पातात्, वृषोऽरिष्टः तस्मात्, मयात्मजाद् व्योमात्, विश्वतोऽन्यस्माद् अपि सर्वतो भयाच् च कालिय-दमनादिना रक्षिताः । — They were protected by the Supreme Personality of Godhead from the poisonous waters, from the serpent-monster Aghasura, from the rain, from the wind, from the lightning, from the fire, from the thunderbolt, from the evil of the bull, from the sky, from My son, from the sky and from all other fears.; किम् इदानीम् उपेक्षसे ? — What are you ignoring now?; इति भावः ॥३॥ — This is the sense.; : अरिष्ट-व्योमासुरयोर् वधस्य भावित्वे ऽपि गर्गादि-मुखाच्
छ्रुतत्वेन विप्रलम्ब-पोषकत्वेन वा भूतवन् निर्देशः । — From the mouths of Garga and others, even in the future of the killing of Arishta and Vyomasura
The instruction is as if it were heard or as a delayed nourisher.
3.translation:
Moreover, after mercifully saving him from many deaths, why do you now send him to kill Manmatha? They say that he is poison. O bull! The best! They were protected by the Supreme Personality of Godhead from the poisonous waters, from the serpent-monster Aghasura, from the rain, from the wind, from the lightning, from the fire, from the thunderbolt, from the evil of the bull, from the sky, from My son, from the sky and from all other fears. What are you ignoring now? This is the sense. From the mouths of Garga and others, even in the future of the killing of Arishta and Vyomasura
The instruction is as if it were heard or as a delayed nourisher.

4.word_for_word: अपि च विश्व-पालनायावतीर्णस्य तव भक्तोपेक्षाऽत्यन्तम् अनुचितेत्य् आशयेनाहुः----न खल्व् इति । — Moreover, they say, with the intention that it is extremely inappropriate to neglect Your devotee, who has descended to rule the universe.; हे सखे, भवान् खलु निश्चितं यशोदा-सुतो न भवति, किं तु सर्व-प्राणिनां बुद्धि-साक्षी । — O friend, you are certainly not the son of Yaśodā, but you are the witness of the intelligence of all living beings.; ननु स किं दृश्यो भवति ? — Indeed, what is he visible?; तत्राहुः----विखनसा ब्रह्मणा विश्व-पालनाय प्रार्थितः सन् सात्वतां कुले उदेयिवान् उदित इति ॥४॥ — There it is said that having been requested by Brahma to rule the universe by excavation he rose up in the family of the Satvatas and is said to have risen.
4.translation: Moreover, they say, with the intention that it is extremely inappropriate to neglect Your devotee, who has descended to rule the universe. O friend, you are certainly not the son of Yaśodā, but you are the witness of the intelligence of all living beings. Indeed, what is he visible? There it is said that having been requested by Brahma to rule the universe by excavation he rose up in the family of the Satvatas and is said to have risen.

5.word_for_word: तस्मात् त्वद्-भक्तानाम् अस्माकम् एतत् प्रार्थना-चतुष्टयं सम्पादयेत्य् आहुः---विरचिताभयम् इत्य्-आदि चतुर्भिः । — Therefore, they say, “Please fulfill these four prayers of our devotees of Your Lordship.”; हे वृष्णि-धुर्य ! — O Vrishni-dhurya!; संसृतेर् भयात् ते चरणम् ईयुषां शरणं प्राप्तानां प्राणिनां विरचितं दत्तम् अभयं येन, तत् तथा । — That is what He has created and given safety to those who have come to Your feet for refuge from the fear of material existence.; हे कान्त ! — O beloved!; कामदं वरदं, तथा श्रियः करं गृह्णातीति तथा तद् भवत्-कर-सरोरुहं नः शिरसि देहि ॥५॥ — Give us that lotus of Thy hand which bestows desires and boons, and which takes the hand of the goddess of fortune.
5.translation: Therefore, they say, “Please fulfill these four prayers of our devotees of Your Lordship.” O Vrishni-dhurya! That is what He has created and given safety to those who have come to Your feet for refuge from the fear of material existence. O beloved! Give us that lotus of Thy hand which bestows desires and boons, and which takes the hand of the goddess of fortune.

6.word_for_word: हे व्रज-जनार्तिहन् ! — O Vraja-janartihan!; हे वीर ! — O hero!; निज-जनानां यः स्मयो गर्वः, तस्य ध्वंसनं नाशकं स्मितं यस्य तथा-भूत ! — The smile which is the pride of his own people, The smile which destroys it, so-being!; हे सखे ! — O friend!; भवत्-किङ्करीर् नोऽस्मान् भज आश्रय । — Serve us, Your servants, and take refuge in us.; स्म इति निश्चितम् । — I’m sure we were.; प्रथमं तावज् जल-रुहाननं चारु योषितां नो दर्शय ॥६॥ — First of all show us the beautiful women with water-blooded faces.
6.translation: O Vraja-janartihan! O hero! The smile which is the pride of his own people, The smile which destroys it, so-being! O friend! Serve us, Your servants, and take refuge in us. I’m sure we were. First of all show us the beautiful women with water-blooded faces.

7.word_for_word: अविशेषेण प्रणताणां देहिनां पाप-कर्शनं पाप-हन्तृ ! — The sin-pulling of the bodies that are bowed down in particular, the sin-killer!; तृण-चरान् पशून् अप्य् अनु गच्छति कृपयेति तथा सौभाग्येन श्रियो निकेतनं वीर्यातिरेकेण फणिनः फनास्व् अर्पितं ते पदाम्बुजं नः कुचेषु कृणु कुरु । — He follows even the grass-grazing animals, saying, “Please have mercy on us.” Please, fortunately, offer Your lotus feet to the tail of the phoenix, the abode of beauty, with the excellence of prowess.; किम्-अर्थम् ? — What-does it mean?; हृच्छयं कामं कृन्धि छिन्धि ॥७॥ — Cut off the desire of the heart and cut it off.
7.translation: The sin-pulling of the bodies that are bowed down in particular, the sin-killer! He follows even the grass-grazing animals, saying, “Please have mercy on us.” Please, fortunately, offer Your lotus feet to the tail of the phoenix, the abode of beauty, with the excellence of prowess. What-does it mean? Cut off the desire of the heart and cut it off.

8.word_for_word: हे पुष्करेक्षण ! — O Pushkarekshan!; तवैव मधुरया गिरा वल्गूनि वाक्यानि यस्यां, तया बुधानां मनोज्ञया हृद्यया गम्भीरयेत्य् अर्थः । — This means that with Your own sweet voice, which contains sweet words, You should deepen the hearts of the wise with Your pleasant words.; मुह्यतीर् इमा नो विधि-करीः किङ्करीर् अधर-सीधुना आप्याययस्व संजीवयेति ॥८॥ — These maidservants who are doing the rituals of ours are bewildered. Please give us water to drink with the nectar of your lips and revive them.
8.translation: O Pushkarekshan! This means that with Your own sweet voice, which contains sweet words, You should deepen the hearts of the wise with Your pleasant words. These maidservants who are doing the rituals of ours are bewildered. Please give us water to drink with the nectar of your lips and revive them.

9.word_for_word: किं च, अस्माकं त्वद्-विरहे प्राप्तम् एव मरणं, किन्तु त्वत्-कथामृतं पाययद्भिः सुकृतिभिर् वञ्चितम् इत्य् आहुः---तव इति । — Moreover, they say that death has come to us in separation from You, but that we have been deceived by those who have done good deeds who drink the nectar of Your story.; कथा एव अमृतम् । — The story is the nectar.; अत्र हेतुः---तप्त-जीवनम्। — The reason here is the hot life.; प्रसिद्धामृताद् उत्कर्षम् आहुः---कविभिर् ब्रह्मविद्भिर् अपि ईडितं स्तुतम् । — They say that it is superior to the famous nectar: it is praised by poets and even by the Brahma-vidya.; देव-भोग्यं त्व् अमृतं तैस् तुच्छीकृतम् । — They have despised the nectar that is enjoyable by the gods.; किं च, कल्मषापहं काम-कर्म-निरसनम् । — Moreover, it destroys impurities and eliminates desires and actions.; तत् त्व् अमृतं नैवं-भूतम् । — That’s not nectar, it’s not like that.; किं च, श्रवण-मङ्गलं श्रवण-मात्रेण मङ्गल-प्रदम् । — What’s more, it’s auspicious to hear, and it’s auspicious to hear it alone.; तत् त्व् अनुष्ठानापेक्षम् । — That, however, is dependent on the ritual.; किं च, श्रीमत् सुशान्तम्, तत् तु मादकम् । — What’s more, it’s beautiful and peaceful, but it’s intoxicating.; एवं-भूतं त्वत्-कथामृतम् आततं यथा भवति तथा ये भुवि गृणन्ति निरूपयन्ति, ते जना भूरिदा बहु-दातारः । — Those on earth who recite and describe the nectar of Your story as it has been spread are generous and generous.; जीवितं ददतीत्य् अर्थः । — It means that it gives life.; यद् वा, एवं-भूतं त्वत्-कथामृतं ये भुवि गृणन्ति, ते भूरिदाः पूर्व-जन्मसु बहु दत्तवन्तः सुकृतिन इत्य् अर्थः । — Or rather, it means that those who recite the nectar of Your story on earth, which has become so, are very generous and have given much in their previous lives and have done good deeds.; एतद् उक्तं भवति---ये केवलं कथामृतं गृणन्ति, तेऽपि तावद् अतिधन्याः, किं पुनर् ये त्वां पश्यन्ति, अतः प्रार्थयामहे त्वया दृश्यताम् [२] इति ॥९॥ — It is said that those who merely recite the nectar of the story are so very blessed, what to speak of those who see You, therefore we pray that You may see us.
9.translation: Moreover, they say that death has come to us in separation from You, but that we have been deceived by those who have done good deeds who drink the nectar of Your story. The story is the nectar. The reason here is the hot life. They say that it is superior to the famous nectar: it is praised by poets and even by the Brahma-vidya. They have despised the nectar that is enjoyable by the gods. Moreover, it destroys impurities and eliminates desires and actions. That’s not nectar, it’s not like that. What’s more, it’s auspicious to hear, and it’s auspicious to hear it alone. That, however, is dependent on the ritual. What’s more, it’s beautiful and peaceful, but it’s intoxicating. Those on earth who recite and describe the nectar of Your story as it has been spread are generous and generous. It means that it gives life. Or rather, it means that those who recite the nectar of Your story on earth, which has become so, are very generous and have given much in their previous lives and have done good deeds. It is said that those who merely recite the nectar of the story are so very blessed, what to speak of those who see You, therefore we pray that You may see us.

10.word_for_word: ननु मत्-कथा-श्रवणेनैव निर्वृता भवत, किं मद्-दर्शनेन ? — If you are satisfied by hearing my story, what about seeing me?; न, त्वद्-विलास-क्षुभित-चित्ता वयम्, तत्रापि शान्तिं न विन्दाम इत्य् आहुः---प्रहसितम् इति । — No, we are disturbed by your luxury, and we cannot find peace even there, they say, and it is laughable.; हे प्रिय, कुहक कपट, संविदः सङ्केत-नर्माणि ॥१०॥ — O dear, deceitful, deceitful, consciousness, signs and jokes.
10.translation: If you are satisfied by hearing my story, what about seeing me? No, we are disturbed by your luxury, and we cannot find peace even there, they say, and it is laughable. O dear, deceitful, deceitful, consciousness, signs and jokes.

11.word_for_word: किं च, त्वयि वयम् अतिप्रेमार्द्र-चित्तास् त्वं पुनर् अस्मासु केन हेतुना कपटम् आचरसि ? — And what, we are so fond of you, why do you deceive us again?; इत्य् आहुः श्लोक-द्वयेन---चलसि इति । — They say in two verses: You are walking.; हे नाथ ! — O Lord!; हे कान्त ! — O beloved!; यत् यदा व्रजाच् चलसि पशूंश् चारयन्, तदा तन् नलिन-सुन्दरं कोमलं ते पदं शिलैः कणिशैस् तृणैर् अङ्कुरैश् च सीदति क्लिश्येद् इति नो मनः कलिलताम् अस्वास्थ्यं गच्छति प्राप्नोति । — That when you walk from Vraja grazing the cattle, that lotus-beautiful, tender foot of yours is covered with stones, grains, grass and sprouts, and our minds become dull and unhealthy.; एवंभूतास् त्वद्-दुःख-शङ्कित-चित्ता वयम् ॥११॥ — Thus we are, our minds suspicious of Your suffering.
11.translation: And what, we are so fond of you, why do you deceive us again? They say in two verses: You are walking. O Lord! O beloved! That when you walk from Vraja grazing the cattle, that lotus-beautiful, tender foot of yours is covered with stones, grains, grass and sprouts, and our minds become dull and unhealthy. Thus we are, our minds suspicious of Your suffering.

12.word_for_word: त्वं तु दिन-परिक्षये सायं-काले नील-कुन्तलैर् आवृतं घन-रजस्वलं गो-रजश्-छुरितं वनरुहाननम् अलि-माला-कुल-पराग-च्छुरित-पद्म-तुल्यम् आननं बिभ्रत् । — At the end of the day, in the evening, you wore a face covered with blue locks, thick and dusty, and your face was covered with cow dust.; तच् च मुहुर् मुहुर् दर्शयन् नो मनसि केवलं स्मरं यच्छस्य् अर्पयसि । — And that’s what you’re showing us again and again, and you’re just giving us a reminder in our minds.; न तु सङ्गं ददासीति कपटस् त्वम् इति भावः ॥१२॥ — This means that you are a hypocrite because you do not give association.; : स्मरं स्मरण-मात्रेणापि क्षोभकम् । — Smara is disturbing even by the mere remembrance.
12.translation: At the end of the day, in the evening, you wore a face covered with blue locks, thick and dusty, and your face was covered with cow dust. And that’s what you’re showing us again and again, and you’re just giving us a reminder in our minds. This means that you are a hypocrite because you do not give association. Smara is disturbing even by the mere remembrance.

13.word_for_word: अतोऽधुना कपटं विहायैवं कुर्व् इति प्रार्थयन्ति श्लोक-द्वयेन---प्रणत-कामदम् इति । — Therefore, now, in two verses, they pray that you should abandon hypocrisy and do this: “I bow down and desire.”; हे अधिहन् ! — O Adhihan!; हे रमण ! — O Raman!; पद्मजेन ब्रह्मणा अर्चितम् । — It is worshiped by the lotus-bearing Brahman.; आपदि ध्येयं ध्यान-मात्रेणापन्-निवर्तकं । — In times of calamity, meditation alone can prevent disasters.; शन्तमं च सेवा-समयेऽपि सुखतमं ते चरण-पङ्कजं काम-ताप-शान्तये नः स्तनेष्व् अर्पय इति ॥१३॥ — Offer Thy lotus feet, which are soothing and most pleasant even at the time of service, to our breasts for the relief of lust and suffering.
13.translation: Therefore, now, in two verses, they pray that you should abandon hypocrisy and do this: “I bow down and desire.” O Adhihan! O Raman! It is worshiped by the lotus-bearing Brahman. In times of calamity, meditation alone can prevent disasters. Offer Thy lotus feet, which are soothing and most pleasant even at the time of service, to our breasts for the relief of lust and suffering.

14.word_for_word: अपि च, हे वीर ! — Also, O hero!; तेऽधरामृतं नो वितर देहि । — Give us the nectar of your lips.; स्वरितेन नादितेन वेणुना सुष्ठु चुम्बितम् इति नादामृत-वासितम् इति भावः । — This means that it is well kissed by the sound of the flute and is fragrant with the nectar of the sound.; इतर-राग-विस्मारणं नृणाम् इतरेषु सार्वभौमादि-सुखेषु रागम् इच्छां विस्मारयति विलापयतीति तथा तत् ॥१४॥ — Forgetting of other attachments makes men forget their attachment to other pleasures such as the sovereign and others and causes them to lament.
14.translation: Also, O hero! Give us the nectar of your lips. This means that it is well kissed by the sound of the flute and is fragrant with the nectar of the sound. Forgetting of other attachments makes men forget their attachment to other pleasures such as the sovereign and others and causes them to lament.

15.word_for_word: किं च, क्षणम् अपि त्वद्-अदर्शने दुःखं, दर्शने च सुखं दृष्ट्वा सर्व-सङ्ग-परित्यागेन यतय इव वयं त्रुटिः क्षणार्धम् अपि युगवद् भवति । — Moreover, by seeing pain in not seeing You even for a moment and happiness in seeing You, we, like ascetics, renounce all association and our error becomes like an age even for a moment and a half.; एवम् अदर्शने दुःखम् उक्तम् । — Thus the pain of not seeing is said.; पुनश् च कथञ्चिद् दिनान्ते ते तव श्रीमन् मुखम् उद् उच्चैर् ईक्षमानानां तेषां दृषां पक्ष्मकृद् ब्रह्मा जडो मन्द एव । — And again, somehow at the end of the day, as they looked up at your beautiful face, the Brahman, who had made their eyelids, was dull and slow.; निमेष-मात्रम् अप्य् अन्तरम् असह्यम् इति दर्शने सुखम् उक्तम् ॥१५॥ — It is said that the difference of even a moment is unbearable and that it is pleasant to see.
15.translation: Moreover, by seeing pain in not seeing You even for a moment and happiness in seeing You, we, like ascetics, renounce all association and our error becomes like an age even for a moment and a half. Thus the pain of not seeing is said. And again, somehow at the end of the day, as they looked up at your beautiful face, the Brahman, who had made their eyelids, was dull and slow. It is said that the difference of even a moment is unbearable and that it is pleasant to see.

16.word_for_word: तस्मात् हे अच्युत ! — Therefore, O Acyuta!; पतीन् सुतान् अन्वयांस् तत्-संबन्धिनो भ्रातॄन् बान्धवांश् च अतिविलङ्घ्य तव समीपम् आगता वयम् । — We have left behind our husbands, children, relatives, brothers and relatives to come to You.; कथं-भूतस्य ? — How-of the ghost?; गति-विदोऽस्मद्-आगमनं जानतः, गीत-गतीर् वा जानतः, गति-विदो वयं वा । — Those who know the pace know our arrival, or they know the pace of the song, or we know the pace.; तवोद्गीतेन उच्चैर् गीतेन मोहिताः, हे कितव ! — They are fascinated by your loud song, O Kitav!; शठ ! — Cheating!; एवं-भूता योषितो निशि स्वयम् आगतास् त्वाम् ऋते कस् त्यजेत् ? — Who would leave you except the women who came by themselves at night?; न कोऽपीत्य् अर्थः ॥१६॥ — No one, that is, no one.
16.translation: Therefore, O Acyuta! We have left behind our husbands, children, relatives, brothers and relatives to come to You. How-of the ghost? Those who know the pace know our arrival, or they know the pace of the song, or we know the pace. They are fascinated by your loud song, O Kitav! Cheating! Who would leave you except the women who came by themselves at night? No one, that is, no one.

17.word_for_word: अतस् त्वया त्यक्तानाम् अस्माकं प्राक्तन-त्वद्-दर्शन-निदान-हृद्-रोगस्य त्वत्-सङ्गत्यैव चिकित्सां कुर्व् इत्य् आशयेनाहुर् द्वयेन---रहसि इति । — Therefore, with the hope that we, whom you have abandoned, will be treated for our past heart disease by seeing you and diagnosing you, they say in two ways: “You are hiding.”; श्रियो धाम ते बृहद् विशालम् उरश् च वीक्ष्य अतिस्पृहा भवति । — I am very eager to see your large, spacious chest, the abode of the goddess of fortune.; तथा च मुहुर् मुहुर् मनो मुह्यति ॥१७॥ — And so again and again the mind is deluded.
17.translation: Therefore, with the hope that we, whom you have abandoned, will be treated for our past heart disease by seeing you and diagnosing you, they say in two ways: “You are hiding.” I am very eager to see your large, spacious chest, the abode of the goddess of fortune. And so again and again the mind is deluded.

18.word_for_word: तव च व्यक्तिर् अभिव्यक्तिर् व्रज-वनौकसां सर्वेषाम् अविशेषेण वृजिन-हन्त्री दुःख-निरसनीति विश्व-मङ्गलं सर्व-मङ्गल-रूपा च । — Your personality is the manifestation of all the inhabitants of the forests of Vraja, without distinction, and you are the destroyer of all troubles and the reliever of suffering.; अतस् त्वत्-स्पृहात्मनां त्वत्-स्पृहारूढ-मनसां नो मनाग् ईषत् किम् अपि त्यज मुञ्च । — Therefore, for our minds, whose minds are fixed on Your longing, please give up and release us from anything.; कार्पण्यम् अकुर्वन् देहीत्य् अर्थाः। — The meanings are to give without being carnal.; किं तत् ? — What is that ?; स्वजन-हृद्-रोगाणां यद् अतिगोप्यं निषूदनं निवर्तकम् औषधं, तत् त्वम् एव वेत्सीति गूढाभिप्रायम् ॥१८॥ — The mysterious intention is that you alone know the most secret medicine that destroys and prevents the diseases of the hearts of your relatives.
18.translation: Your personality is the manifestation of all the inhabitants of the forests of Vraja, without distinction, and you are the destroyer of all troubles and the reliever of suffering. Therefore, for our minds, whose minds are fixed on Your longing, please give up and release us from anything. The meanings are to give without being carnal. What is that ? The mysterious intention is that you alone know the most secret medicine that destroys and prevents the diseases of the hearts of your relatives.

19.word_for_word:
अतिप्रेम-धर्षिता रुदत्य आहुः---यद् इति । — Overwhelmed with love, they cried and said, “What is it?”; हे प्रिय ! — O dear one!; यत् ते तव सुकुमारं पदाब्जं कठिनेषु कुचेषु संमर्दन-शङ्किताः शनैर् दधीमहि धारयेम वयम् । — That’s what we’re going to hold, slowly milking your delicate lotus feet, fearing they’ll rub against your hard breasts.; त्वं तु तेन आटवीम् अटसि । — You’re stuck in the forest with it.; \"नयसि\" इति पाठे पशून् वा काञ्चिद् अन्यां वा आत्मानम् एव वा नयसि प्रापयसि । — In the text \"you are taking\" you are taking animals or someone else or yourself.; तत् ततः, तत् पदाम्बुजं वा कूर्पादिभिः सूक्ष्म-पाषाणादिभिः किं स्विन् न व्यथते ? — That then, doesn't that sole of the foot or the stump and the fine stones hurt Swin?; कथं नु नाम न व्यथेत ? — How can the name not be hurt?; इति भवान् एव आयुर् जीवनं यासां, तासां नो धीर् भ्रमति मुह्यतीति ॥१९॥ — Thus You alone are the life-span of those whose minds are wandering and bewildered.; : दधीमहि धर्तुं योग्यम् । — Let’s give it a drink that’s worth holding.; "अर्हे कृत्यतृचश् च" इति लिङ् । — "Arhe and Krityatrichas" is the gender.; : भवदायुषाम् इति । — Your lifetimes.; इत्थम् एव च \"त्वयि धृतासवः\" इत्य्
उपक्रमो ऽपि । — And so it is with \"the breaths held in you\"
The undertaking is also.
19.translation:
Overwhelmed with love, they cried and said, “What is it?” O dear one! That’s what we’re going to hold, slowly milking your delicate lotus feet, fearing they’ll rub against your hard breasts. You’re stuck in the forest with it. In the text \"you are taking\" you are taking animals or someone else or yourself. That then, doesn't that sole of the foot or the stump and the fine stones hurt Swin? How can the name not be hurt? Thus You alone are the life-span of those whose minds are wandering and bewildered. Let’s give it a drink that’s worth holding. "Arhe and Krityatrichas" is the gender. Your lifetimes. And so it is with \"the breaths held in you\"
The undertaking is also.
